description: The class of a remote upstream's failure that ended a generation, as an error's `reason` field names it, with the fixed caller-facing message of an `inference_error` of that class. A worker sends only these names; the gateway forwards only these names and answers with this text, never the worker's own message. `worker_terminal_error` is the error object a worker publishes on its terminal chunk when its upstream answered 402.

reasons.upstream_credential_unavailable: the server has no usable credential for its upstream
reasons.upstream_credential_rejected: the upstream rejected the server's credential
reasons.upstream_payment_required: the upstream account cannot pay for the request
reasons.upstream_model_not_found: the upstream has no route for the configured model
reasons.upstream_unavailable: the upstream could not be reached, timed out or failed
reasons.upstream_not_ready: the model is not ready on the upstream
reasons.upstream_invalid_response: the upstream answered with something the server cannot accept

worker_terminal_error.message: the upstream account cannot pay for the request
